title: Custom CarPlay Widgets & Live Lyrics Dashboard #shorts
description:
Custom CarPlay widgets and a live lyrics dashboard on your iOS 27 CarPlay screen. See how a custom CarPlay dashboard turns the screen into music, clocks and widgets you actually want. Swipe through widget pages without leaving your music.

CarPlay tips for drivers in the USA: Chicago, Dallas, Seattle, Atlanta.

Search Car Widgets: AutoDash on the App Store.
